name: 酒精使用障碍筛查量表
instructions: 以下问题涉及你的饮酒情况。请根据你的实际情况选择最符合的一项。“一杯”指一个标准杯（约含10克纯酒精）。
instructionsEn: The following questions concern your drinking. Please choose the option that best matches your actual situation. “One drink” means one standard drink (containing about 10 grams of pure alcohol).
license: 世界卫生组织（WHO）编制，可免费使用，使用时请注明出处。

items.text: 你多久喝一次含酒精的饮料？
items.textEn: How often do you have a drink containing alcohol?

items.text: 在饮酒的日子里，你通常喝多少杯？
items.textEn: On a day when you drink, how many drinks do you usually have?

items.text: 你多久一次在一次场合喝6杯或以上？
items.textEn: How often do you have six or more drinks on one occasion?

items.text: 过去一年里，你多少次发现一旦开始喝酒就无法停止？
items.textEn: In the past year, how often have you found that you were unable to stop drinking once you had started?

items.text: 过去一年里，你多少次因喝酒而没能做应该做的事？
items.textEn: In the past year, how often have you failed to do what was normally expected of you because of drinking?

items.text: 过去一年里，你多少次在大量饮酒后的第二天早上需要先喝一杯才能让自己清醒？
items.textEn: In the past year, how often have you needed a first drink in the morning to get yourself going after heavy drinking the night before?

items.text: 过去一年里，你多少次在喝酒后感到内疚或悔恨？
items.textEn: In the past year, how often have you had a feeling of guilt or remorse after drinking?

items.text: 过去一年里，你多少次因喝酒而记不起前一天晚上发生的事？
items.textEn: In the past year, how often have you been unable to remember what happened the night before because of drinking?

items.text: 你或他人是否曾因你喝酒而受伤？
items.textEn: Have you or someone else been injured because of your drinking?

options.label: 有过，但不在过去一年
options.labelEn: Yes, but not in the last year

items.text: 是否有亲友、医生或其他卫生工作者关心你的饮酒情况或建议你减少饮酒？
items.textEn: Has a relative, friend, doctor, or other health worker been concerned about your drinking or suggested that you cut down?

options.label: 有过，但不在过去一年
options.labelEn: Yes, but not in the last year

totalBands.description: 提示存在有害饮酒风险，建议适当减少饮酒。
提示饮酒风险较高，建议寻求专业评估与帮助。
提示可能存在酒精依赖，请尽快寻求专业帮助。
